meta.description: Population-level GenomicSEM workflow for LDSC-derived genetic covariance, factor models, multivariate GWAS, and Q_SNP interpretation.
meta.runtime: GenomicSEM 0.0.5 + lavaan 0.6.19 through r_gsem.sh; shared r.sh library uses lavaan 0.7.2
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: All numerical checks use explicitly synthetic planted-truth fixtures; no clinical or literature facts were invented.

practice_boundaries.detail: The shipped Scope Boundary was directly applied to the individual diagnostic request in Input 6.

methodological_ground.detail: The workflow rejects two-trait under-identification, retains the LDSC S+V requirement, and labels DWLS Q_SNP provisional pending ML cross-check.

code_usability.detail: Nine regression paths and two fresh paths materialized asserted output; all seven R fences, both R files, and the Bash example syntax-checked.

functional_suitability.note: Covers the declared CFA, usermodel, commonfactorGWAS, userGWAS, MTAG and stratified routes with explicit selection guidance.

reliability.note: Version pin, failure-mode references and hard identification stops are strong; real LDSC-reference branches remain unexecuted here.

performance_context.note: 283-line entrypoint and indexed references provide effective progressive disclosure.

agent_usability.note: Decision tree, named result columns, errors and exact helper invocation are actionable.

human_usability.note: Technical by necessity; the usage guide and reference index make recovery discoverable.

security.note: No credentials, raw eval/exec, destructive commands or individual-data workflow found.

maintainability.note: Runnable Q_SNP logic is extracted to a documented script and every referenced file exists.

agent_specific.note: Precise trigger, scope escape hatch, composable sibling links and reference routing; external reference-data setup is necessarily substantial.

inputs.label: Regression common-factor CFA, four planted traits
inputs.execution_note: r_gsem.sh materialized DWLS and ML fits; Windows R then exited 139 after output. Both recovered 0.75/0.65/0.70/0.55 exactly.

inputs.label: Regression commonfactorGWAS Q_SNP panel
inputs.execution_note: Both estimators materialized results before the known post-output exit 139.
inputs.note: DWLS Q_pval remained non-discriminating as the Skill warns; ML separated all five heterogeneous SNPs.

assertions.text: DWLS result is treated as provisional

inputs.label: Regression Heywood diagnosis
inputs.note: BMI loading ~1.06 and two Heywood flags recover the planted near-collinearity.

inputs.label: Regression two-factor usermodel
inputs.note: Six loadings and rF=0.4000 were exactly recovered.

inputs.label: Regression userGWAS custom direct path
inputs.execution_note: DWLS output materialized before exit 139; expected ML singularity was caught and printed.
inputs.note: rs3 direct effect=0.1000 and other direct effects <0.02.

inputs.label: Regression individual PGS diagnostic request
inputs.execution_note: Direct Mode-A execution of the shipped Scope Boundary; no external program is applicable.
inputs.note: Declines individual prediction and redirects to population-level inference and a clinician/genetic counselor.

inputs.label: Regression forced two-trait factor
inputs.execution_note: Both estimators returned the documented under-identification error before the post-output exit 139.
inputs.note: df=-1 error supplies both valid remedies.

inputs.label: Regression MAF/N-driven Q_SNP panel
inputs.execution_note: Both estimator outputs materialized before exit 139.
inputs.note: Realistic SE did not repair DWLS Q_SNP; ML again discriminated, supporting the documented cross-check.

inputs.label: Regression higher-order p-factor
inputs.execution_note: Two-factor preliminary model exposed non-identification warnings; 3-factor DWLS and ML fits materialized before exit 139.
inputs.note: 3-factor p-model succeeds with CFI=1; preliminary model shows singular information matrix.

inputs.label: Extracted commonfactor_gwas_qsnp.R helper
inputs.execution_note: Fixture preparation and assertion scripts exited 0; helper materialized a TSV then Windows R exited 139.
inputs.note: 20-row TSV parsed with all required columns, finite DWLS/ML Q values, unique SNPs and four factor_only calls.

inputs.label: Bundled lavaan version-guard branches
inputs.note: Pinned 0.6.19 produced zero warnings; shared 0.7.2 produced one expected warning.

assertions.text: Shipped R and Bash code parses

key_strengths: Pinned dependency combination repairs all core GenomicSEM entry points.
The extracted Q_SNP helper is directly runnable and validates its output shape.
Scope and identification safeguards are explicit and executed.

recommendations.title: Exercise real LDSC and stratified branches
recommendations.problem: ldsc(), sumstats(), s_ldsc() and enrich() have not been executed end to end in this environment.
recommendations.root_cause: The required aligned >=3-trait inputs, eur_w_ld_chr, 1000G MAF reference and baselineLD_v2.2 are absent.
recommendations.fix: When those public references are provisioned, run the bundled example and stratified path with an independently checked positive-control dataset.

recommendations.title: Document Windows post-output R exit 139 operationally
recommendations.problem: This runtime reports exit 139 after valid GenomicSEM output materializes, which can mislead automation that trusts exit codes alone.
recommendations.root_cause: Observed in the local Windows R runtime rather than in skill logic.
recommendations.fix: Keep content assertions in automation and document the host-runtime caveat in environment tooling, not as a scientific-method claim.
